Theorem
[rank rigidity in nonpositive curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0402 ↗ cor:pet-ch10-nontransitive-holonomy 1. ch10:10.3.6A compact Riemannian manifold of nonpositive curvature and rank $\ge 2$ does not have transitive holonomy; in particular it is either reducible or locally symmetric.
